useCases.title: Use cases
useCases.body: We defined a set of use cases representative of generative AI use, in a personal or professional context, through the main providers of LLM-based generative AI tools.
useCases.cumulative: The main benefit over other calculators is that these use cases add up, to simulate their cumulative impact over a day or a year, for one or more people (for instance a team or a company).

frequency.title: Usage frequency
frequency.principle: Each use's frequency is entered per day, per week or per month. The calculator converts it into a number of actions per year, based on 218 working days, then into an average per working day: that average drives the “Impact per working day” of each row, so that uses compare whatever their unit.
frequency.example: Example: one video per month counts as 11 videos per year, about 0.05 per working day.

factors.title: Impact factors used
factors.intro: We rely on the <anchor>EcoLogits API</anchor>, with three cases:
factors.direct: use cases that match an existing EcoLogits use case (source: EcoLogits);
factors.custom: use cases based on a specific number of text output tokens (source: EcoLogits, with a custom token count):
factors.customTokens: the output tokens used are given in the dedicated column of the table below;
factors.customRange: the “Range” column gives the minimum and maximum number of output tokens considered for the use case, the basis for the default value;
factors.image: image generation use cases: they transpose the EcoLogits impact factors for video, based on an estimate of the energy (Wh) per image size (see <anchor>Image generation</anchor>).

images.title: Image generation
images.principle: EcoLogits does not model image generation. The results therefore transpose the EcoLogits impact factors for video, based on an estimate of the energy (Wh) per image size.

rows.512: “Common” diffusion model (SDXL or similar), cloud setup and typical number of diffusion steps. The value is the low end of the 0.086 to 4.08 Wh range.
rows.1024: Same model family, doubled resolution: a factor of 5, the high end of the 1.3 to 4.7 range observed in the study from 512 to 1024 px.
rows.2048: Extrapolated from 1024 px: resolution doubled again and heavier setups (more steps, transformer models). A factor of 3.33, mid-range, keeping the same ratios as for the previous cases.

images.study: Source: “The Hidden Cost of an Image: Quantifying the Energy Consumption of AI Image Generation” (<anchor>arXiv 2506.17016</anchor>).
images.reference: The reference value for the transposition is an 8-second 720p video with audio generated by Veo 3.1: 44.1 Wh (27.7 to 60.6 Wh) according to the <anchor>EcoLogits calculator</anchor>, as of September 30, 2026. For one image, that gives:
images.factor: {{size}}: impact factor {{divisor}} times lower than that of a 720p video generated by Veo 3.1;
images.scope: The same factor applies to the five criteria shown and to every provider. The profile shows the image model used (e.g. Gemini 2.5 Flash Image), but its impact is not assessed directly.
